verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirmed a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). The API reference pages show structured request/response schemas, and an llms.txt index adds a further machine-readable docs surface. Missing for 10: first-party docs that announce or describe the spec download, evidence of the spec's completeness across all APIs (Agent, Search, Embeddings, Router), and independent corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
